entry.title: ETH Foundation restructures, HYPE hits ATH, China tariffs delayed
entry.summary:
ETH Foundation restructures, HYPE hits ATH, China tariffs delayed FOMO HOUR EP370
BTC reclaims $105k, ETH leads crypto gains. ETH Foundation restructures, shares new targets. ETH ETF inflows begin to outpace BTC. Robinhood acquires Bitstamp. Strategy to sell equity to raise $250m to buy BTC. HK’s Reitar Logtech to buy $1.5bn BTC. HYPE hits ATH, to get Binance US listing. NBX’s stock up 140% on BTC reserve policy. Tether sends 37k BTC to Twenty One Capital. Metaplanet buys $114m BTC. Blockchain Group buys $68m BTC. Sberbank to issue bonds tied to BTC. Coinbase delayed data breach reveal. Coinbase adds Ethena to listing roadmap. Sharplink down 30%, after 2000% surge. Public co. Classover to raise $500m to buy SOL. SOL signs MOU with Dubai to collab on crypto.
